model: Nomad Mk3 with Rohloff hub 26 with Straight bars
description: Details A New Thorn Nomad Mk3 Step Through frame with Rohloff - Blue - 40ST -Straight Bar . This bike is a new build beat the bike build queue , this bike can also be built with a dynamo hub and headlights if wanted please call for additional cost . This bike would suit a rider of 1574mm (5ft 2in) to 1727 mm (5ft 8in).Virtual top tube 545mm. Lowest step through height 570 mm. Reach tip of saddle to centre of bars 440 mm This bike would be ideal for expedition rides , distance touring, commuting or weekly shop. If unsure of size please contact Thorn on 01278 441505, Monday to Thursday from 8.00am to 4.00pm or sales@thorncycles.co.uk.
